Minister Attached to the Prime Minister's Office visits and gives policy guidance to the Office of the Royal Society
items.excerpt: Today (21 August 2020) at 09:00, Mr. Anucha Nakhasai, Minister Attached to the Prime Minister's Office, visited the Office of the Royal Society to attend a meeting of the Office of the Royal Society's Civil Service Sub-Committee acting as the Ministerial Civil Service Sub-Committee, welcomed by Dr. Duangta Tancho, Secretary-General of the Office of the Royal Society, together with executives, civil servants and staff. At 10:00 he went to survey the Residence of Chao Chom Manda Luean, a historic building for which the Office of the Royal Society has received budget approval for renovation into an office and history hall of the Royal Society of Thailand, separate from the offices of the Office of the Royal Society, which are expected to move from Sanam Suea Pa to the Government Complex Commemorating His Majesty the King's 80th Birthday Anniversary, 5th December B.E. 2550, Zone C, around early 2024. He then returned to visit and give policy guidance to the Office of the Royal Society in the 4th-floor meeting room from 11:00 to 12:00
